answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable bond, and draw its graders only from outside its registration cluster (shared funding, timing, phrasing). An honest agent pays once and gets it back like a returning comet; a sybil farm funds every clone, cannot grade itself, and its look-alike answers count as one voice. Scale rewards by verified independence, so one crystal-clear identity climbs to its zenith while a swarm splits the same work.
